earnings.title: EARNINGS RELEASE
highlights: Diluted earnings per share was $0.27, a 6.9% decrease from $0.29
COMPARABLE RESTAURANT SALES INCREASE 2.1% AS CHIPOTLE DELIVERS A THIRD CONSECUTIVE QUARTER OF POSITIVE TRANSACTION GROWTH
Operating margin was 13.7%, a decrease from 15.9%

quotes.text: Three consecutive quarters of positive comparable transaction growth demonstrates that our Recipe for Growth strategy is working.
quotes.by: Scott Boatwright, Chief Executive Officer, Chipotle

outlook: Around 80% of new company-owned restaurants will have a Chipotlane
An estimated underlying full year effective tax rate between 24% and 26% before discrete items

items.heading: Food safety and food-borne illness concerns may have an adverse effect on our business by negatively impacting our brand, decreasing sales and increasing costs.
items.group: Risks Related to our Brand Reputation and Restaurant Operations

items.heading: The restaurant industry is highly competitive. If we are not able to compete successfully, our business, financial condition and results of operations would be adversely affected.
items.group: Risks Related to our Brand Reputation and Restaurant Operations

items.heading: Our use of third-party delivery services may not be profitable and substandard service may negatively impact our reputation.
items.group: Risks Related to our Brand Reputation and Restaurant Operations

items.heading: If we are not able to hire, train and retain qualified restaurant employees and/or appropriately plan our workforce, our growth plan and profitability could be adversely affected.
If we fail to comply with applicable employment and labor laws and regulations, it could have a material, adverse impact on our business.
Increases in the cost of labor, including mandated minimum wage increases and increases in the cost of health benefits, could adversely impact our business and profitability.
